vsViagraPage.subtitle: Natural support for men's performance, made properly and sold honestly.

introduction.text1: If you are weighing up Varomax against Viagra, here is the honest starting point. Viagra is a prescription medicine (the active drug is sildenafil). Varomax is a natural, herbal food supplement you can buy without a prescription. They are not the same thing, and one does not replace the other.
introduction.text2: What Varomax offers is a natural route for men who would rather skip the synthetic, prescription path, with support for both firmer erections and lasting longer. Below is a straight side by side, then where each one actually makes sense.

rows.feature: Last longer, not just get hard

keyMessage.text: Viagra wins on one thing: it is a clinically proven prescription drug, and that is no small thing. If that is exactly what you want, see your GP. But if you want the natural route, no prescription, support for lasting longer, discreet delivery, and easier on the wallet, Varomax is built for you.

viagraNotOnly.title: Viagra is not your only option
viagraNotOnly.text1: Viagra pulled off something clever. It convinced a whole generation that one little blue pill is the only answer, so most men never look past it. It is a good medicine. It is also a synthetic, prescription-only drug that does a single job: erections.
viagraNotOnly.text2: There is another way. A natural, no-prescription option that supports firmer erections and helps you last longer, working with your own physiology instead of a prescription pad. If you would rather skip the doctor and the synthetic drug, that is Varomax.

medicalDisclaimer.title: One honest point.
medicalDisclaimer.text: Viagra is a clinically proven prescription medicine. Varomax is a food supplement that supports your own physiology, not a drug, and not a substitute for medical care. If your ED came on suddenly or will not shift, see a GP first, as it can be an early warning for heart or circulation problems.

items.question: Is Varomax the same as Viagra?
items.answer: No. Viagra is a prescription medicine (sildenafil); Varomax is a herbal food supplement. Different categories, different ingredients, bought in different ways. Varomax is the no-prescription, natural option.

items.question: Can I take Varomax instead of Viagra?
items.answer: Varomax is a supplement, not a substitute for a medicine a doctor has prescribed. If you have been prescribed Viagra, follow that advice. If you are choosing a natural option without a prescription, Varomax is a reasonable starting point. Do not swap or combine prescribed medicines without speaking to your doctor.

items.question: Is Varomax a natural Viagra?
items.answer: "Natural Viagra" is a popular phrase, but it is not accurate in the strict sense: Varomax is a herbal supplement, not sildenafil. It supports erections and stamina naturally rather than acting as a synthetic drug. The appeal is the natural, no-prescription route, not a copy of the medicine.

items.question: Can I take Varomax and Viagra together?
items.answer: Do not combine a supplement with a prescription ED medicine without talking to your doctor or pharmacist first. This matters most if you take nitrates or blood-pressure medication, or have a heart condition.

items.question: Is it safe with heart or blood-pressure medication?
items.answer: Check with your doctor or pharmacist first. Varomax is a food supplement rather than a medicine, but ingredients that support blood flow can still matter when you are on cardiovascular medication. When in doubt, ask before you start.

faq.title: Varomax – Your questions answered
faq.subtitle: Everything you want to know before you try Varomax.

items.question: How do I take Varomax?
items.answer: Place one troche under your tongue about 30 minutes before. It dissolves and absorbs sublingually, so it acts faster than a capsule you swallow. Do not exceed one troche per day.

items.question: How fast does it work, and how long does it last?
items.answer: Most users feel it within about 30 minutes, and the effect can last several hours. Individual response varies from person to person.

items.question: Is it safe? Are there side effects?
items.answer: Varomax is a natural herbal food supplement and is non-habit forming. As with any supplement, if you take medication or have a heart condition, check with your doctor first. It is not a substitute for medical advice.

items.question: Do I need a prescription?
items.answer: No. Varomax is available over the counter, without a doctor's prescription.

items.question: Is delivery discreet?
items.answer: Yes. Every order ships in plain, unbranded packaging with no mention of the contents, and we ship discreetly worldwide.

items.question: Is Varomax a natural alternative to Viagra?
items.answer: Varomax is a herbal food supplement, not a medicine, so it does not replace any prescription treatment. What it gives you is a natural, no-prescription option for supporting stronger erections without synthetic drugs. It uses plant extracts rather than sildenafil, and you can buy it discreetly with no doctor's appointment.

items.question: Can Varomax help me last longer in bed?
items.answer: Varomax is formulated to support both erection quality and stamina, which is unusual – most products target one or the other. It is not a numbing spray and not a drug, so it works with your own physiology rather than masking sensation. A lot of men use it as much for the lasting-longer side as the erection side.

faq.medicalNote: One honest point. A supplement is support, not a substitute for medical care. If your ED came on suddenly, see a GP first – it can be an early warning for heart or circulation problems. For the everyday dips, stress, tiredness, age, a drink too many – a natural formula is a sensible place to start.
